Since the SSH service requires username for login and the brute force attempt didn't yield success, I will try to enumerate users on the system by other means.

I will try a user enumeration via SSH by sending a signal to check valid users from the server response.

I will use the ssh-user-enum tool to enumerate possible valid usernames on port 2299.
